title: Global Newland Single Pedestal Desk — 60"W x 30"D
body_html:
A clean, classic single-pedestal desk that gives every workstation a durable laminate surface and lockable storage without overspending.

The Global Newland Single Pedestal Desk pairs a 1" thermally fused laminate top with a 2 mm matching edge for surfaces that stand up to daily institutional use. At 60"W x 30"D it suits private offices and open-plan stations alike, with an integrated pedestal for filing, leveling glides for stable placement, and a reversible build that assembles for left- or right-hand layouts. Made in Canada and available across the full Newland finish range, it is a practical desking solution that stands the test of time.

Key features

  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate top with 2 mm matching edge for durable, scratch-resistant wear
  • Single suspended pedestal for filing and supplies storage
  • Leveling glides included for stable placement on uneven floors
  • Reversible build — assembles for left- or right-hand applications
  • Designed for quick and easy assembly
  • Available across the full Newland laminate finish range

Who it’s for

Private offices, open-plan workstations, and administrative areas in school boards, municipal offices, and healthcare facilities that need a dependable, value-driven primary desk.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
